title: History and Evolution of JSON knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of history and evolution of json?
options: A format specification defines syntax/data model; a parser library is an implementation that must be tested against the chosen standard.
A guarantee that every parser will behave identically
questions.answer_key: A format specification defines syntax/data model; a parser library is an implementation that must be tested against the chosen standard.
questions.explanation: The best answer aligns with the lesson concept; parser compatibility and application rules still need separate checks.

questions.prompt: What is the most reliable next step after a document parses successfully?
options: Assume the application will accept it
Validate the expected types/schema and business constraints
questions.answer_key: Validate the expected types/schema and business constraints
questions.explanation: Parsing establishes syntax/constructability, not necessarily schema or business correctness.

questions.prompt: Which practice improves reproducibility when a tool-dependent behavior is involved?
options: Rely only on how the text looks
Record the tool/version and test valid plus invalid inputs
Put credentials in the example file
questions.answer_key: Record the tool/version and test valid plus invalid inputs
questions.explanation: Versioned tests with known inputs expose implementation differences and make findings repeatable.
